[[Dazing | Dazing VIII]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Dazing | Dazing VIII]]:''' On Hit: Your target suffers a -1 Penalty to [[Will]] Saving Throws for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times. This effect may only occur on-hit once every three seconds.
Passive: The DC of the saving throw to resist your [[Stunning Blow]] and [[Stunning Fist]] combat feats is increased by 13.
